SELECT e.*, d.dept_name AS org_name, u.user_name AS user_name, u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.status AS user_status, u.login_ip AS user_login_ip, u.login_date AS user_login_date, u.create_time AS user_create_time, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name SEPARATOR '、') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = e.user_id AND r.(del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0')) AS user_roles FROM biz_hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.org_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
